🚦 TRAFFIC ALERT – GACHIBOWLI 🚦

Traffic movement is slow at Udipi “U” Turn from Gachibowli Junction due to heavy traffic congestion. Cyberabad Police are monitoring and managing the traffic.

Motorists are advised to plan extra travel time and drive safely.
